rawFindings.title: Improper callback invocation on res.sendFile for HEAD and 304 responses
rawFindings.explanation: The patch introduces a `streaming` variable to track whether the file stream has started. In the 'onfinish' handler, the callback is only called if 'streaming' is true. For HTTP HEAD or 304 responses, no data streaming occurs, so the callback was previously incorrectly invoked with an error or not invoked properly. This patch corrects this by ensuring the callback is called without error even when no streaming is performed.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep the new logic which sets 'streaming' to true in the 'onstream' event and calls callback only if streaming occurred. This fixes the incorrect 'Request aborted' error on HEAD and 304 responses by invoking the callback without error.
